cases.title: Gateway spool failure rejects before any state
then: A retryable error; no Control call was made

cases.title: A lost commit acknowledgement is resolved by re-read
cases.when: The commit response is lost, once after commit and once before
then: After commit: re-read finds it and no second row is created
Before: one retry, then a retryable error

cases.title: A unique-constraint loss returns the winner
cases.when: Two submissions with one key commit concurrently
then: The loser reads and returns the winner's row

cases.title: ASK waits while Control is down, then expires
cases.when: Control is down while an approval is pending past its input deadline
then: The task stays AWAITING_APPROVAL, then EXPIRED

cases.title: A lost approval swap reuses the same attempt's state
cases.when: The consume_approval response is lost, then retried by the same invocation and by another
then: Same invocation: reuses the state
Another invocation: refused

cases.title: No permit while the Gateway spool is full
cases.when: The Gateway spool has only headroom left
then: No permit is minted; a retryable error

cases.title: Ledger admission is refused while the store is down
then: REFUSED(STORE_UNAVAILABLE); nothing ran; retry allowed

cases.title: A lost ADMITTED is resolved through the ledger
cases.when: The ADMITTED message is dropped for a ledger tool
then: The Gateway queries by invocationId and never re-dispatches

cases.title: A host spool failure after the claim becomes notStarted
cases.when: The host spool fails right after consume, then also the refusal report fails
then: First: ABANDONED_BEFORE_START and FAILED notStarted
Second: OUTCOME_UNKNOWN with evidence "not started"

cases.title: A heartbeat that cannot commit ends the work at lease end
cases.when: Heartbeats fail for longer than the lease
then: The host terminates the sandbox at lease end; OUTCOME_UNKNOWN

cases.title: Results wait in the host outbox while the store is down
cases.when: Control is down when the result is ready, then recovers
then: The Gateway reports working; the outbox re-sends and the result commits once

cases.title: A result with a stale fencing token is evidence only
cases.when: The invocation was cancelled before the result arrives
then: State stays CANCELLED; the result is recorded as evidence

cases.title: The purge job is idempotent and resumable
cases.when: The purge job is killed half-way and restarted
then: Every eligible payload is tombstoned exactly once

cases.title: Audit ships at least once with dedupe ids
cases.when: The receiver drops acknowledgements, then recovers
then: Records are re-sent and deduplicated; segments truncate only after acknowledgement

cases.title: Above the soft limit an alert is raised
then: Work continues; an alert is raised

cases.title: Primary failover after an acknowledged commit loses nothing
cases.when: The PostgreSQL primary fails over just after acknowledging a T9 commit
then: The result is present on the new primary (synchronous commit)

cases.title: Plain synchronous calls touch only the spools
cases.when: A READ_ONLY sync tool without key, task or ASK is called
then: Rows 1, 5 and 6 go to spools; no invocation task row is written beyond the invocation record
